responsibility: Implements the path-sensitive range_query used by jump threading and similar analyses. Given a reverse-ordered CFG path, it precomputes ranges and relations for exit-dependent SSA names along that path, caches intermediate results, tracks PHI and outgoing-edge relations with a path_oracle, can resolve outside-path inputs through a backing gimple_ranger, and answers range_of_expr/range_of_stmt queries as if only the specified path executed.
same_name_distinction: Implements the path-sensitive solver behind path_range_query, including path traversal, exit-dependency computation, path caches, PHI/outgoing relation handling, and statement/expression evaluation along a specific CFG path. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-path.h, it contains the path-solving algorithms rather than the class declaration and query interface.
